description: Deletes one AI tool from Development — the dashboard's own delete, at once, with no approval: Development's calls to it are refused from then on. Never Live: an AI tool Live has stays in Live, and a promote never removes anything from Live — removing Live's is its own request (request_live_action delete_ai_tool), approved by the founder in their browser. put_ai_tool makes it again. On the founder's Logs.
name: dev_delete_ai_tool
title: Development: delete an AI tool
